response.answer: Before joining, require a verification-first operating model: database access and protected time to check claims; written pre-briefs or source-backed talking points; explicit permission to say "not yet verified" and defer an answer; clear attribution and escalation for uncertain statistics; and a rapid written correction process. The twice-daily cadence, high scrutiny, and incentive to sound decisive make those safeguards essential—especially given your prior experience of an unverified live statistic creating a widely circulated correction. This recommendation is based only on your stated preference for prepared, written work and the risks you described around live briefings.
